Asset type: premium website photograph for the custom 3D printing page "По твоја мерка" of GrandXStudio. Landscape 3:2 composition.

Scene: a beautifully restrained maker's workbench in a bright small 3D printing studio. Arrange these three finished real products on a pale oak worktop: the vase slightly back, the phone holder at front left, the pink LED holder at front right. The phone holder is palm-sized and smaller than the vase. The LED holder retains its softly illuminated artificial flame. Vase is EMPTY. A few small unbranded material color swatch chips in warm orange #FE7F2D, ivory and olive sit naturally beside them; one subtle orange filament spool softly out of focus at the rear suggests material choice and customization.
Style: sophisticated editorial product photography, realistic visible FDM layers and delicate ribbed textures, tactile matte PLA rather than ceramic, beautiful soft daylight from the left, cream plaster wall, gentle natural shadows, minimal art direction.
Composition: all products fully visible, well separated, cluster within middle 75% of frame with 12% clear space around edges, camera at a slightly elevated three-quarter angle. Balanced for display at 560 px wide on a website. Warm orange is an accent, preserve the actual products' colors. No people, no text, no lettering, no logos, no watermark, no sketches implying original design authorship, no Christmas objects. Do not invent or redesign a product.
